hero.name: I Putu Andika Prasetya
hero.title: AI Engineer | Machine Learning & Data Engineer
hero.tagline: I forge AI systems — from raw data to deployed intelligence.
dialogue: Greetings, traveler! You've reached the world of Andika Prasetya — an AI Engineer who builds things that actually run.
He trains language models, wires up knowledge graphs, and automates entire pipelines. Then he puts gloves on and spars. Balance.
Dig down to see what he's forged. Mind the slimes.
taglines: I put the 'AI' in Terraria... wait, no.

text: I'm a fresh Information Technology graduate from Universitas Udayana (GPA 3.91) and a Bangkit Academy graduate with Distinction (Top 10%), based in Bali.

I build AI systems end to end. That means NLP models for Indonesian language, knowledge-graph RAG, and automated data pipelines — and I care about the unglamorous parts that make them trustworthy: clean data, deterministic metrics, logging, and containers that start on the first try.

My thesis combined IndoBERT-based textual entailment with IndoT5 to summarize Indonesian news, and I'm turning it into journal manuscripts. Outside code I train combat sports — it taught me the same loop I use in engineering: show up, take the hit, review the tape, iterate.
Currently looking for: AI Engineer / Machine Learning / Data Engineering roles.

skills.name: Python
skills.desc: Core weapon for ML and Backend.

projects.title: The Summarizer's Tome
projects.subtitle: Hybrid summarization for Indonesian news
projects.description: A hybrid summarization system that reads the news the way an editor does. IndoBERT-based textual entailment picks the sentences that matter, then IndoT5 rewrites them into fluent abstractive summaries. Evaluated on Tempo.co and Liputan6 across three premise strategies, backed by a 29,587-article corpus.

projects.title: Octagon Oracle
projects.subtitle: UFC knowledge graph + GraphRAG
projects.description: Ask questions about fighters, bouts and styles and get answers grounded in a knowledge graph — not guesses. A resumable scraper feeds Neo4j AuraDB; spaCy, sentence-transformers and LangChain power retrieval, served through FastAPI and Streamlit on a free-tier stack.

projects.title: The Stitchworks Loom
projects.subtitle: Business-process automation for fashion manufacturing
projects.description: A simulated fashion factory run end to end: order → production → QC → packing → shipping → reporting. Mock APIs, a PostgreSQL data layer, Python ETL and deterministic KPI calculation, dashboards — and an LLM that only narrates the numbers, never computes them.

projects.title: Iron Fist Coach
projects.subtitle: A boxing & gym coach that lives in Telegram
projects.description: A personal AI coach for boxing and gym training: it chats, sends nightly summaries and scheduled reminders, and deduplicates notifications in Postgres. Orchestrated with n8n workflows on FastAPI and PostgreSQL, all in Docker Compose.

projects.title: The Merchant's Ledger
projects.subtitle: Daily Shopify discount report
projects.description: Every morning, an email lands with the Shopify orders that redeemed the fixed-amount welcome discount. Pulls data through the Shopify Admin GraphQL API, stores it in Google Sheets or a local JSON file, and runs on a launchd schedule.

projects.title: Pulse of the Marketplace
projects.subtitle: Shopify store monitoring
projects.description: A read-only Shopify dashboard that extracts data securely via the Admin GraphQL API. It features scheduled syncs to a DuckDB backend for reliable analytics without hammering the live store.

projects.title: Warden of the Feed
projects.subtitle: Hate-speech detection for Indonesian tweets
projects.description: A fine-tuned IndoBERTweet classifier that flags hate speech in Indonesian social media text. Evaluated on a 3,240-sample dataset, achieving a 91.52% F1 score and an AUC of 0.9777. The inference is served by FastAPI with a Streamlit interface.
